reason: A batch report I can actually check, a known dose and no magnesium oxide is what I look for, and the first box at $24.99 is low enough to just try. Pre-counted sachets help because I forget things on the counter.
objection: No reviews yet since it is a brand new product, and Made in China. I would want to open the lab report and see that the batch number really matches before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the product page was missing, did not match the batch number, or the lab was not one I could look up, I would not buy.
